name: OpenTTD
description: The source supports a narrow plugin/content observation: the BaNaNaS channel downloads and installs AI/GameScript and other content, and the cited receive path writes and extracts it. This is not evidence for the primary application updater tier; the local MD5 matching and the separate signature subsystem do not establish signature protection for this network content path.
limitations: Newly retrieved snapshot at the recorded commit, not historical release verification.
The observation is limited to downloaded content/plugin scope; primary tier is unresolved.
HTTP/TLS implementation and any server-side or packaging controls are outside the cited function bodies.
